01 — Print & Illustration

Zaan

A café menu, cover to back.

Print Design Illustration Direction Arabic / English Type

A full print menu for Zaan, a café built around an old olive tree. Every section — sandwiches, mains, drinks, hookah — is hand-illustrated and set bilingually in Arabic and English, bound front to back by the same olive-branch line work as the storefront sign.

02 — Web Design

Dignity

Academic Initiative, Birzeit University

Website Bilingual UX Editorial Layout

The site for Birzeit University's Dignity Academic Initiative — a research hub for faculty, fellows, and partners, structured around long-form publications, dialogue, and news, set in both Arabic and English.

03 — Product Design

Aqar

"Find a place to call your own."

Mobile App UI / UX Design System

A real-estate app concept for the Palestinian market — buying, long- and short-term rentals, and chalets in one flow. An editorial serif carries moments of voice, while a calm navy-and-olive interface runs through onboarding, search, filters, and listings.
